# wallix.bastion.authdomain_mapping

Map directory groups to user groups on a WALLIX Bastion — module

*Added in version 1.1.0 of `wallix.bastion`.*

## Synopsis

- Create or delete the mapping of a group of an authentication domain (a directory) to a Bastion user group. Members of the directory group get the user group, and its profile, when they log in.
- Works with every type of authentication domain ([`wallix.bastion.authdomain_ad`](authdomain_ad.md), [`wallix.bastion.authdomain_ldap`](authdomain_ldap.md), [`wallix.bastion.authdomain_saml`](authdomain_saml.md), [`wallix.bastion.authdomain_azuread`](authdomain_azuread.md)).
- Equivalent of the `wallix-bastion_authdomain_mapping` Terraform resource.
- A mapping is identified by the domain, [`user_group`](#parameter-user-group) and [`external_group`](#parameter-external-group) together, since the Bastion allows several mappings per user group and per directory group. There is nothing else to update. To map a user group to another directory group, add the new mapping and remove the old one.

## Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Comments |
|---|---|---|
| <a id="parameter-api-version"></a>**api_version** | `str` | Version of the Bastion REST API to use, `v3.8` or `v3.12`.<br>If not set, the value of the `WALLIX_BASTION_API_VERSION` environment variable is used, then `v3.12`. |
| <a id="parameter-bastion-host"></a>**bastion_host** | `str` | Hostname or IP address of the WALLIX Bastion.<br>If not set, the value of the `WALLIX_BASTION_HOST` environment variable is used. |
| <a id="parameter-bastion-password"></a>**bastion_password** | `str` | Password of [`bastion_user`](#parameter-bastion-user).<br>If not set, the value of the `WALLIX_BASTION_PASSWORD` environment variable is used.<br>One of [`bastion_password`](#parameter-bastion-password) or [`bastion_token`](#parameter-bastion-token) is required. |
| <a id="parameter-bastion-port"></a>**bastion_port** | `int` | HTTPS port of the WALLIX Bastion API.<br>If not set, the value of the `WALLIX_BASTION_PORT` environment variable is used, then `443`. |
| <a id="parameter-bastion-timeout"></a>**bastion_timeout** | `int` | Timeout in seconds of each HTTP request to the Bastion API.<br><br>Default: `30` |
| <a id="parameter-bastion-token"></a>**bastion_token** | `str` | API key of [`bastion_user`](#parameter-bastion-user). Takes precedence over [`bastion_password`](#parameter-bastion-password).<br>If not set, the value of the `WALLIX_BASTION_TOKEN` environment variable is used. |
| <a id="parameter-bastion-user"></a>**bastion_user** | `str` | User to authenticate with. With [`bastion_token`](#parameter-bastion-token), the user the API key belongs to.<br>If not set, the value of the `WALLIX_BASTION_USER` environment variable is used. |
| <a id="parameter-csrf-enabled"></a>**csrf_enabled** | `bool` | Send the CSRF token the Bastion issues at login (Bastion 12.0.3 and later).<br>If not set, the value of the `WALLIX_CSRF_ENABLED` environment variable is used, then `true`. |
| <a id="parameter-domain-name"></a>**domain_name** | `str` / required | Name of the authentication domain, which must exist.<br>The Terraform resource takes the id of the domain instead (`domain_id`). |
| <a id="parameter-external-group"></a>**external_group** | `str` / required | The group as the directory names it, for example the distinguished name of an LDAP or Active Directory group (`CN=Linux Admins,OU=Groups,DC=corp,DC=example,DC=com`), or the group claim value for SAML.<br>Compared without regard to case, like the Bastion does. |
| <a id="parameter-state"></a>**state** | `str` | Whether the mapping should exist.<br><br>Choices: `present` (default), `absent` |
| <a id="parameter-user-group"></a>**user_group** | `str` / required | Name of the Bastion user group. It must exist and have a profile (see [`wallix.bastion.usergroup`](usergroup.md)). |
| <a id="parameter-validate-certs"></a>**validate_certs** | `bool` | Whether to validate the Bastion's TLS certificate.<br>Only disable this for test instances with self-signed certificates.<br>If not set, `WALLIX_BASTION_VALIDATE_CERTS` is used, then the inverse of `WALLIX_INSECURE_SKIP_VERIFY`, then `true`. |

## Attributes

| Attribute | Support | Description |
|---|---|---|
| **check_mode** | full | Can run in check_mode and return changed status prediction without modifying target. |
| **diff_mode** | full | Will return details on what has changed (or possibly needs changing in check_mode), when in diff mode. |

## Notes

- The environment variables are the ones of the `wallix/wallix-bastion` Terraform provider, so one shell configuration serves both tools.
- Set the connection options once per play with `module_defaults` and the `group/wallix.bastion.bastion` action group.
- These modules call the Bastion API from the host they run on; use them with `delegate_to` or on a play targeting `localhost`.

## See also

- [`wallix.bastion.authdomain_mapping_info`](authdomain_mapping_info.md)

## Examples

```yaml
- name: Give the Linux administrators of the directory the linux-admins user group
  wallix.bastion.authdomain_mapping:
    domain_name: corp
    user_group: linux-admins
    external_group: CN=Linux Admins,OU=Groups,DC=corp,DC=example,DC=com

- name: Remove the mapping
  wallix.bastion.authdomain_mapping:
    domain_name: corp
    user_group: linux-admins
    external_group: CN=Linux Admins,OU=Groups,DC=corp,DC=example,DC=com
    state: absent
```

## Return values

| Key | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| <a id="return-changed-fields"></a>**changed_fields** | `list / elements=str` | Always empty, a mapping has nothing to update.<br><br>Returned: when the mapping already existed and [`state=present`](#parameter-state)<br><br>Sample: `[]` |
| <a id="return-mapping"></a>**mapping** | `dict` | The mapping as returned by the Bastion API.<br>In check mode, the expected mapping. `null` when [`state=absent`](#parameter-state).<br><br>Returned: always<br><br>Sample: see [below](#sample-mapping) |

<a id="sample-mapping"></a>

### Sample of `mapping`

```yaml
domain: corp
external_group: CN=Linux Admins,OU=Groups,DC=corp,DC=example,DC=com
id: 1a0f768a6439af09005056b66c8b
url: https://bastion.example.com/api/v3.12/authdomains/1a0f76781900a85d005056b66c8b/mappings/1a0f768a6439af09005056b66c8b
user_group: linux-admins
```
